cover_letter:
Dear 24Flow team,

I'm excited to apply for the Medior Digital Marketeer position. Your focus on increasing qualified inbound leads through hands-on ownership of digital channels matches how I approach marketing: monitor, diagnose, fix, and report.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions. I also write keyword-targeted blog content to grow organic traffic. This hands-on experience has taught me to spot underperformance and act before being asked.

On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site and implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. This project reflects my passion for experimenting with new tools and my drive to understand how search is evolving.

I also maintain CRM records and follow-up for a cleaning-services client at Episto, giving me practical exposure to marketing operations. I'm comfortable learning new CRM and marketing-automation tools, and I'm keen to apply that to your stack, including AppExchange optimization and LinkedIn lead generation.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp, and work in English and Turkish; my Dutch is B1 and I'm taking classes to improve. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to 24Flow's inbound growth.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
